note.zh-TW: 模板寫「應收帳款周轉率」並用期末餘額；介面統一寫「週轉率」，模板寫法列為別名。
note.en: The template uses a variant character and the closing balance; the interface uses one spelling and keeps the template wording as an alias.

definition.zh-TW: 一年內應收帳款被收回、再重新賒出去幾次。次數越多表示收款越快，賒銷的錢卡在客戶手上的時間越短。
definition.en: How many times a year receivables are collected and extended again through new credit sales. More turns mean faster collection and less money tied up with customers.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
